verification.precondition: A new surveyctl run uses one explicit empty external key root.
verification.stimulus: Initialize the run and inspect key directory, key file, and persisted session bytes.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The registry is mode 0700, its single-link 32-byte key is mode 0600, and session state contains no key carrier.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: surveyctl creates an external owner-only key registry and never embeds key bytes in session state
verification.forbiddenMutation: Initialization must not place authentication bytes or their hexadecimal encoding inside session.json.

behavior: surveyctl creates an external owner-only key registry and never embeds key bytes in session state
